As an Entrepreneur, I want to start a pilot from an opportunity so I can capture progress and evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pilot creation form with name, timeline, team, and template selection.
- Pilot dashboard created with default milestones and owner assigned.
- Evidence upload works and displays preview.
